durationSeconds.description: Video duration in seconds without fractional rounding.

transcodeStatus.description: Transcode state such as complete, error, or in_progress; null when unavailable.

items.description: A video summary from the requested Watch Later queue, with video ownership and metadata timestamps.
One page of videos in the specified user's Watch Later queue in Vimeo's returned order, not the authenticated user's uploaded videos.

total.description: Vimeo-reported number of resources in the filtered queue collection, only when supplied; not a count inferred from this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the next page; omitted when no next page is reported. Results are not a stable snapshot.

FunctionOutput_vimeo_listwatchlatervideo.description: One ordered page of Watch Later video summaries and provider-reported continuation information.

tags.instructions: Use this for Watch Later membership, not uploaded videos; use `list-uploaded-videos` for the latter. Supply the queue owner's Vimeo user ID from your account context or a known user reference; video ownerId values identify video owners, not necessarily queue owners. Use `get-video` to inspect a result. Request 1–100 items, default 25. Continue by passing nextCursor as cursor with the same userId, filters, order, and limit. Private scope does not grant access to arbitrary users' queues.

functions.name: search-users
functions.description: Find Vimeo users with a text query and retrieve one page of matching profiles.

sort.description: Provider ordering key; omission preserves its default ranking.

limit.description: Maximum user profiles requested in one result page, default 25.

query.description: Ordinary provider user-search text; no exact-match, email-search or advanced syntax guarantee is implied.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation scoped to this connection and unchanged search.

direction.description: Ordering direction; omission uses Vimeo's descending default.

FunctionInput_vimeo_searchusers.description: Text query and optional ordering, page size, and continuation for Vimeo user search.

id.description: Opaque Vimeo user ID.

bio.description: User biography, or null when none is supplied.

url.description: Browser URL of the user profile.

createdAt.description: Account creation instant normalized to UTC Z.

items.description: A matching Vimeo user profile.
Matching user profiles in provider order for this page.

nextCursor.description: Opaque next-page continuation; omitted when exhausted.

FunctionOutput_vimeo_searchusers.description: One page of matching Vimeo user profiles and an optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover user IDs for `get-user`, `list-user-followers` and `list-user-following`. It uses provider text matching, not exact email or identifier matching. Continue with nextCursor as cursor using the same query, order and limit.
